description: Extend the cell diffing mechanism to support forced width calculations for cells containing escape sequences. Currently, escape sequences always cause cells to be marked as multiwidth, even when their visual width differs from the escape sequence length. This feature will allow widgets to specify exact visual widths for diffing purposes.
functional_requirements: Replace the boolean 'skip' parameter in cell diffing with an enum that includes a 'ForceWidth' option to specify exact visual width
Ensure diffing operations remain idempotent when using forced width options (no repeated diffs)
Support three use cases: 1) Hyperlinks with escape sequences squeezed into first cell, 2) Hyperlinks with sequences split across multiple cells, 3) Kitty image sequences with UTF-8 placeholders
